name: Sun Disc grants a raid-wide 6% healing-taken aura and boosts Illumination healing by 20% (#1028)
contract: Sun Disc 560547 is family 33, Attributes 65600 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE) with EquippedItemClass -1; Stances 134217728 is gated by Player::IsNeedCastPassiveSpellAtLearn, but AttributesEx2 1074266112 carries SPELL_ATTR2_ALLOW_WHILE_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED (bit 0x80000), so it still self-applies on learn for an unshapeshifted caster. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER with ApplyAuraName SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT (118), EffectBasePoints 5 + DieSides 1 = 6; Unit::SpellHealingBonusTaken folds this into the receiver's incoming-healing multiplier, and Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura spreads the same aura instance to nearby raid members, so this is not "no server-side implementation". Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE) and EffectSpellClassMask word1 512 (0x200), matching Illumination 500143's own SpellFamilyFlags word1 512; EffectBasePoints 19 + DieSides 1 = 20. Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone applies modOwner->ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, heal) unconditionally at the end of the function. spell_healing_done queries SpellHealingBonusDone directly with a fixed base of 1000 and no cast submitted, so with no other modifiers a fresh talent fixture resolves to exactly 1200.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The nearby grouped ally receives the same aura
The ally's spread aura carries exactly 6%
Control's Illumination healing is the plain fixed base
Talent's Illumination healing is boosted by exactly 20%
